projects.name: LEDGER: Self-Verifying RAG
projects.description: A self-verifying RAG system for U.S. federal budget and energy reports that decomposes generated answers into atomic factual claims, checks each claim against retrieved source evidence using a local 7–8B model, and rewrites or removes unsupported statements.
highlights: Diagnosed a Docling table-parsing defect affecting 5.5% of table cells and implemented PDF text-layer reconstruction, raising held-out table-cell accuracy from 30.5% to 100% on Economic Report of the President tables
Distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry and a self-hosted Arize Phoenix instance on AWS EC2
Crash-safe, resumable Batch API evaluation runner and 223 automated tests in GitHub Actions CI

projects.name: TheraMind: Dual-Mode Clinical LLM Agent
projects.description: A clinical LLM agent fine-tuned from Llama 3.2-3B using QLoRA and DPO on 9,250 clinical dialogues, improving ROUGE-L from 0.40 to 0.78 with a 19.5-minute training runtime on an RTX 4090. One model runs patient intake, then writes a structured SOAP note for the doctor.
highlights: ChromaDB-based RAG for clinical intake and note generation, combining retrieval-grounded responses, safety prompts, constrained decoding, and prompt-injection testing to reduce cross-mode contamination risks
Direct Preference Optimization with β = 0.1 using 49 preference pairs derived from model errors and reference responses, kept separate from supervised fine-tuning
Served with FastAPI in Docker on Hugging Face Spaces

projects.name: BreachLens
projects.description: Python and KNIME pipeline that extracts PII/PHI from synthetic breach documents (PDFs, scanned forms and messy Excel/CSV exports), validates it, verifies addresses with the U.S. Census geocoder, and matches people across files into one privacy-safe notification list per state.
highlights: Notification list matched the ground truth exactly: 155/155 on the dev corpus and 159/159 on an untuned holdout
Person matching at 1.000 pairwise precision; a 50,000-row file runs end to end in about 39 seconds
Raw identifiers never reach an output file, only masked values and salted HMAC keys
